ingredient_groups.title: The Homemade Pudding Custard
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Evaporated milk**: 680 g ([**1:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=77s))
- **Brown sugar**: 400 g *(Used for a richer, deeper flavor than white sugar)* ([**1:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=68s))
- **Large egg yolks**: 6 yolks
- **Cornstarch**: 30 g ([**0:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=15s)) *(Note: The video description mistakenly lists all-purpose flour, but Aaron explicitly measures and uses cornstarch to thicken the scratch-made base)* ([**0:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=15s))
- **Butter**: 57 g
- **Vanilla paste**: 5 mL

ingredient_groups.title: The Salted Caramel Sauce
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Granulated sugar**: 300 g
- **Butter**: 187 g (Ideally a rich European-style butter like Kerrygold to reduce popping) ([**9:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=566s))
- **Heavy cream**: 250 mL ([**1:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=91s))
- **Sea salt**: 5 mL

ingredient_groups.title: The Layering Inclusions
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Bananas**: 6 small bananas ([**18:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1092s))
- **Lotus Biscoff cookies**: 1 package ([**17:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1076s)) *(An excellent alternative if you live somewhere like Austria where standard Nilla wafers aren't available)* ([**17:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1068s))

steps.title: Step 1: Prep a Cold Mixing Bowl
steps.body: - Place a metal mixing bowl straight into the fridge or freezer ([**3:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=229s)). Whipping cream succeeds best when both the equipment and cream are icy cold ([**3:57**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=237s)).

steps.title: Step 2: Start the Pudding Liquid
steps.body: - Set a heavy pot over medium heat ([**0:45**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=45s)). Pour in 400 g of brown sugar, 500 mL of evaporated milk, and 237 mL of heavy cream ([**0:54**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=54s)). Whisk together and bring the mixture to a boil ([**5:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=320s)).

steps.title: Step 3: Mix the Egg Base and Temper
steps.body: - In a separate bowl, whisk your 6 egg yolks with 30 g of cornstarch until smooth ([**0:38**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=38s)). Once your milk mixture boils, turn off the heat ([**5:42**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=342s)). Slowly drizzle a few splashes of the hot liquid into the eggs while whisking vigorously ([**6:33**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=393s)). This tempers the eggs so you do not accidentally scramble them ([**6:45**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=405s)).

steps.title: Step 4: Thicken and Strain the Custard
steps.body: - Pour the tempered egg mixture back into the main pot ([**7:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=450s)). Stir as the residual heat cooks down and visibly thickens the pudding ([**7:42**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=462s)). Remove from the stove and melt in 57 g of butter ([**8:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=508s)). Stir in 5 mL of vanilla paste ([**12:24**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=744s)). Press the pudding through a fine mesh strainer into a bowl to ensure an ultra-smooth finish ([**12:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=731s)), then set it aside to chill ([**11:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=719s)).

steps.title: Step 5: Melt the Caramel Sugar
steps.body: - In a separate pot over medium heat, add 300 g of regular granulated sugar ([**2:09**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=129s)). Let it sit undisturbed until the sugar melts down into a golden amber liquid ([**4:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=251s)). Scrape the sides occasionally so it does not burn ([**6:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=386s)).

steps.title: Step 6: Finish the Salted Caramel Sauce
steps.body: - Turn off the heat and drop 187 g of butter into the amber sugar ([**8:51**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=531s)). Once the butter melts, pour in 237 mL of heavy cream and 5 mL of sea salt ([**10:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=631s)). It will bubble up fiercely but keep stirring until it forms a unified sauce ([**9:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=566s)). Run the caramel through a clean strainer, transfer it to a jar, and let it cool ([**10:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=649s)).

steps.title: Step 7: Whip the Cream and Fold
steps.body: Retrieve your frozen metal bowl ([**14:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=876s)). Add your heavy cream and 5 mL of vanilla paste ([**14:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=886s)), then whip until soft-to-medium peaks form ([**14:57**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=897s)). Pull your chilled pudding base out of the freezer and gently fold the whipped cream into it a little at a time ([**15:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=940s)). This incorporates air, making the pudding beautifully light and fluffy ([**14:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=870s)).

steps.title: Step 8: Chop the Bananas
steps.body: Peel your bananas and slice them ([**16:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1012s)). Cutting them on a slight diagonal yields great, chunky bites for the final assembly ([**18:21**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1101s)).

steps.title: Step 9: Layer, Chill, and Serve
steps.body: - Grab a glass serving dish ([**20:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1215s)). Lay down a foundation layer of Biscoff cookies, followed by a layer of diagonal banana slices ([**18:33**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1113s)). Drizzle a generous amount of your homemade salted caramel right over the fruit, and then spread a thick layer of the fluffy pudding over the top ([**19:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1141s)). Repeat the layering process until the dish is filled ([**19:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1153s)). Place the completed dish into the freezer or fridge to chill completely before serving ([**20:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1211s)).
